## material.create

Creates a material asset (.stmat) from the default material with the given property values. Returns {asset, warnings}: textures whose import usage does not fit their slot (see material.get).

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `assets` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorAssetCommands.cpp:1146`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |   | Path relative to the asset directory, e.g. &quot;Materials/Red.stmat&quot;. |
| `properties` | object | no |   | Property values, e.g. {&quot;BaseColor&quot;: \[1, 0, 0, 1\], &quot;Roughness&quot;: 0.3, &quot;BaseColorMap&quot;: &quot;Textures/Brick.png&quot;}; texture maps take a texture by path or handle, null clears them. Properties: BaseColor, Metallic, Roughness, EmissiveColor, EmissiveIntensity, NormalScale, OcclusionStrength, AlphaMode, AlphaCutoff, DoubleSided, Unlit, UVTiling, UVOffset, BaseColorMap, MetallicRoughnessMap, NormalMap, OcclusionMap, EmissiveMap, Clearcoat, ClearcoatRoughness, ClearcoatMap, ClearcoatRoughnessMap, ClearcoatNormalMap, Transmission, TransmissionMap, IOR, Thickness, AttenuationColor, AttenuationDistance (material.get describes their types). |

## material.get

A material asset's property values, and every material property with its type, range or options: what material.create and material.set accept. &quot;saved&quot; is false while values previewed with material.set {save: false} are not saved. &quot;warnings&quot; lists texture maps whose import usage does not fit their slot (a Color texture as the normal map, color in Metal/Rough or Occlusion, a normal map or data as color): \[{property, texture, usage, expected, message, fix: {command, parameters}}\]; run fix (asset.setImportSettings) to import the texture as the slot reads it.

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `assets` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorAssetCommands.cpp:1120`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `material` | string | yes |   | Material: handle, path or Builtin/DefaultMaterial (asset handle, or path relative to the asset directory). |

## material.set

Changes property values of a material asset of the project; entities using it show the change in the same frame. By default it saves the material (one undo step, edit.undo restores the file and the loaded values); save: false only previews the values in the loaded material (no file is written, no undo step), e.g. while a value is dragged, until a saving material.set (which saves them too), an undo or a reload replaces them. Returns the material's values and warnings (texture maps whose import usage does not fit their slot, with the command that fixes each: see material.get).

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `assets` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorAssetCommands.cpp:1178`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `material` | string | yes |   | Material (asset handle, or path relative to the asset directory). |
| `properties` | object | yes |   | Property values to change, e.g. {&quot;BaseColor&quot;: \[1, 0, 0, 1\]}. Properties: BaseColor, Metallic, Roughness, EmissiveColor, EmissiveIntensity, NormalScale, OcclusionStrength, AlphaMode, AlphaCutoff, DoubleSided, Unlit, UVTiling, UVOffset, BaseColorMap, MetallicRoughnessMap, NormalMap, OcclusionMap, EmissiveMap, Clearcoat, ClearcoatRoughness, ClearcoatMap, ClearcoatRoughnessMap, ClearcoatNormalMap, Transmission, TransmissionMap, IOR, Thickness, AttenuationColor, AttenuationDistance (material.get describes their types). |
| `save` | boolean | no |   | Save the material and record an undo step (default true); false previews the values without saving. |
